purpose: New primary matched experiment at EL20 -> IM30; replace main-result tables only after authentic outputs exist, regardless of outcome. Not an attempt to prove that extending training had no effect.
existing_v13: previously prepared candidate; preserve; do not assume author adoption

arm_roles.W_two_perm: same HLA-wise W_two distribution with rank-to-row correspondence shuffled
arm_roles.L_perm: same permutation as W_two_perm; original HLA-wise L distribution
arm_roles.L_const: constant positive weight per HLA equal to original HLA-specific L mean

training.optimizer: AdamW; verify original configuration, optimizer-state transitions and defaults
training.EL_actual_sampler: original one-positive plus 16-negative batching; authenticate actual behavior rather than silently redefining batch size
training.IM_sampler: original native implementation; record skipped all-negative batches
training.EL_loss: mean(row_weight * BCEWithLogits(reduction=none)) over original batch rows; no sum-of-weights normalization
training.teacher: original authenticated zero-retaining teacher, not the sensitivity-refit substitute
training.epoch_selection: fixed final EL20 and IM30; no external-performance selection
training.initialization_and_order: paired within training seed across all six arms; independent permutation RNG; retain original row/sampler order

Neo.component_scope: exact peptide; not authenticated independent patients

control_definition.reference: all 63053 original EL-training positive observations, 49 HLA groups
control_definition.permutation_unit: positive rows within each HLA; fixed across all epochs; duplicates remain observations; report duplicate peptide-HLA cases
control_definition.permutation_seed: SHA256(namespace|training_seed|HLA), interpreted as an integer for a local random.Random instance
control_definition.constant_mean_matching: exact HLA-specific original L mean before FP32 cast; record actual FP32 mean-rounding discrepancy

evaluation.top_k_ties: fractional inclusion at the tied cutoff, not arbitrary row-order tie breaking
evaluation.score: saved positive_probability, higher is positive; no score-direction fitting

bootstrap.shared_across: all 36 arm/seed/stage score vectors within each cohort
bootstrap.point_estimate: arithmetic mean of paired seed-specific metric differences, not an ensemble score metric
bootstrap.CI: unadjusted fixed-model conditional percentile interval; no future-seed or unknown patient uncertainty
bootstrap.invalid_draw_handling: original kernel; document counts; never alter grouping or replace draws based on outcomes

evaluation.IM20: save checkpoint and training metrics for traceability; not a competing primary endpoint
evaluation.largest_component_sensitivity: predeclared secondary IMPROVE analysis, remove original largest 2475-row component (62 positives), retain original remaining 37 component IDs; do not pick mask by effect

official_diagnostics.native_aggregation: mean of member probabilities before evaluation; confirm pinned official code
official_diagnostics.overlap: audit against identifiable official training data; unknown ancestry remains unknown
official_diagnostics.unavailable_handling: attempt official public acquisition in a new directory, record concrete failures; lack of a local cached weight is not proof of unavailability

not_authorized_in_this_task: new teacher fitting or teacher replacement
handoff_policy: aggregate results/code/figures/source tables with all private model/score/label/component mappings retained on WSL unless existing transfer permissions explicitly cover them
